captions.detailed: This 3D model presents a print-in-place, folding pencil case shown in its flat, unfolded state alongside a small, separate cylindrical pencil topper. The pencil case consists of five main panels connected by interlocking, integrated hinge segments along their edges, allowing it to fold up into a three-dimensional rectangular box. One of the outer panels features a clean, embossed text label reading 'Fantastic' in a stylized font, while the opposite side panel features a beveled edge with ruler tick marks and a circular finger hole cutout. The separate pencil topper is a small block featuring stylized pixelated letter cutouts on its faces and a hexagonal socket on the bottom.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, print-in-place folding pencil case with integrated hinges that can fold from a flat plate into a box. It should include parameters for customizing the embossed text, font size, case dimensions (width, length, height, thickness), and hinge tolerances, as well as an optional 8-bit style pencil topper.
captions.factory: The design uses a modular assembly where 'wordcase' is the main assembly containing a 'base', two 'x_side' panels, two 'y_side' panels, and two 'lid' panels. These panels are modeled using 'cube' primitives with rounded hinge edges created from 'cylinder' and 'sphere' primitives, which are then subtracted using 'difference' with a repetitive 'hinge' generator module. The 'hinge' module uses a 'for' loop to create alternating 'hinge_link' shapes made of cubes and cylinders with conical tips. The custom text is rendered on the side panel using 'linear_extrude' on a 2D polygon path retrieved from an external font library index, and the pencil topper is built by subtracting a 'letter' module and 'corner' cubes from a central 'cube'.
